## Checklist

- [ ] `node tools/check.mjs --base origin/main` passes
- [ ] Tests pass (`node --test extensions/*/*.test.js`), or there is nothing to test
- [ ] The README says what it does, which sites it runs on, and why it asks for each grant and `@connect`
- [ ] No data leaves the page except what the README says
- [ ] Tried in a MyPack app (or Violentmonkey/Tampermonkey) on the sites it runs on
